verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents 30 idiomatic official SDKs (13 client-side, 13 server-side, 4 edge), including a Cloudflare SDK reference and official OpenFeature providers. Community users independently describe building with its SDKs, including the mobile client SDK and SDK clients that download flags and stream changes. Missing for 10: the pack has detailed per-language reference evidence only for the Cloudflare edge SDK, and no AI-native-specific SDK guidance (llms.txt and docs.md probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: 30 idiomatic SDKs 13 client-side, 13 server-side, and 4 edge SDKs.
If you are using Cloudflare SDK version 2.3.0 or later, you can use the Cloudflare SDK by itself.
LaunchDarkly offers official OpenFeature providers for several of our SDKs
LaunchDarkly SDKs can pass any context attributes you want to LaunchDarkly, where you can then use those attributes in flag targeting.
LaunchDarkly clients download all flags in the project on connection, then stream changes.
